questions.question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

He said, "I have completed the task."

options.text: He said that he has completed the task.
He said that he was completing the task.
He said that he completed the task.
He said that he had completed the task.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He said that he had completed the task.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"I have completed the task" becomes "He had completed the task"**
 
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "he" to match the subject of the indirect sentence.
 
• Verb "have completed" is converted to "had completed" to shift the tense from present perfect to past perfect.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "He said that" introduces the reported speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is converted into a subordinate clause introduced by "that".
 
• Quotation marks are removed, and the sentence is transformed into a declarative statement.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He said that he had completed the task."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He said that he has completed the task." 

 
 
• Incorrect tense: "has completed" remains in the present perfect instead of shifting to past perfect.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "He said that he was completing the task." 
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "was completing" suggests an action in progress, altering the meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "He said that he completed the task." 
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "completed" does not match the required past perfect tense.

options.text: He said, "Did you be aware of the policies of the company?"

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He asked if I had been aware of the policies of the company.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"if I had been aware" becomes "Were you aware"**
 
 
• Indirect question "if I had been aware" is converted to direct question "Were you aware."
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "you" to match direct speech.
 
• Verb tense "had been" is changed to "were" to match direct speech format.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "Were" and ends with a question mark "?".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a lowercase letter after the comma.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Were you aware of the policies of the company?" he asked.*

questions.question:

__
 
• In the sentence, "He is one of those players who has scored the most goals," the pronoun "**who**" refers to "**players**," which is plural.
 
• When referring to plural antecedents, the correct verb form is "**have scored**" rather than "**has scored**."
 
• Thus, "**have scored**" is the grammatically correct option, ensuring subject-verb agreement.
 
• Options like "**had been scoring**" or "**had scored**" imply past perfect tense, which does not fit the context here.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He is one of those players who **have scored** the most goals."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
